newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to buy up to $500 mln in loans.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to buy up to $500 mln in loans.

text.p: Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae) said on Friday that it agreed to purchase up to $500 million in education loans under an arrangement with the Princeton Review and Apply Technology.

Apply Technology, makers of a CD-ROM containing college applications, and the Princeton Review are entering a partnership with Sallie Mae to provide a computerized system for college selection, college applications and financial aid in one place, Sallie Mae said.
Princeton Review publishes 100 book titles on education and provides college admissions test preparation courses.
Sallie Mae's total portfolio of loans managed totals $40.8 billion as of March 31.
